account.intro: You can delete your account and your data from here. This cannot be undone.
account.privacy: Privacy policy: what we keep, for how long, and your rights
account.exportHint: Want to keep a copy first? Download what this device holds of your babies' records as a JSON file.
account.exportHintProfessional: Want to keep a copy first? Download your professional profile, the notes and suggestions you wrote and the measurements you recorded, as a JSON file. Your patients' records are not included.
account.exportFailed: This browser could not save the file.
account.exportProfessionalFailed: Could not get your data from the server. Check your connection and try again.
account.previewFailed: Could not check what the deletion affects. Try again.
account.willDelete: These babies and all their records will be deleted, because nobody else uses them:
account.willLeave: You will leave these babies. Their records stay for the other members, and the entries you added stay without your name:
account.blocked: You are the only owner of these babies, and other people use them. Make another member an owner, or remove the other members, then try again:
account.whatElse: Your reminders, notes only you can see and doctor profile are deleted too.
account.identityWillGo: Your sign-in account at our sign-in server (name, email and password) is deleted too.
account.identityWillStay: This server does not delete your sign-in account at our sign-in server (name, email and password): it stays, without any baby data, until the administrator removes it. You can ask for that with the contacts in the privacy policy.
account.unsynced: {{changes}} on this device have not reached the server yet and will be lost.
account.understand: I understand that this is permanent.
account.doneBody: Your data was deleted. Select Finish to leave the app.
account.identityKept: Your data was erased. Your sign-in account at our sign-in server still exists, because this server cannot delete it by itself. It holds no baby data. Ask the administrator to remove it, using the contacts in the privacy policy.
account.identityFailed: Your data was erased, but deleting your sign-in account at our sign-in server failed. It holds no baby data. To try again, sign in later and delete the account once more, or ask the administrator to remove it (contacts in the privacy policy).
